question: Charlie starts from point A and drives 5 km towards the South. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 3 km and 2 km, respectively. He takes a final right turn and drives 3 km to reach point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only. unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Charlie starts from point A and drives 5 km towards the South. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 3 km and 2 km, respectively. He takes a final right turn and drives 3 km to reach point B.
